runs.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset: orthographic albedo texture-source painting for the Hesper energy coupler hes_coupler_3.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the exact 1024 x 1024 orthographic geometry guide. Input 2 is design_reference.png, MATERIAL AND COLOUR REFERENCE ONLY. Paint directly inside Input 1's existing object pixels. Preserve its alpha silhouette, all part boundaries, camera, pose, scale, position, occlusions and negative spaces exactly. Do not redraw the object in the reference image's perspective. Output one 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG on genuine transparent background. Keep the large transparent margins of the guide; do not enlarge or recenter the object.
Use the reference's warm white ceramic with extremely fine restrained wear/crazing, brushed yellow gold with subtle fine grain, and vivid cyan/blue-white energy in the guide's existing light-blue strips. Only narrow existing recesses may use the dark resin colour seen in the reference. The guide's grey/cream/light-blue tints label materials, not the final palette. Continue unseen faces with the same materials. Add only fine surface seams, panel joins and engraved lines within the existing parts, no text or letters or symbols.
Lighting: FLAT, EVEN, SHADOWLESS ALBEDO from the viewer. Remove all grey directional shading and cast shadows present in the guide. Ceramic stays evenly warm white on every face. Gold is its mid golden base colour with at most a faint sheen, no white specular highlights. The cyan strips are bright intrinsic colour only, no bloom or light spill. No ambient occlusion, directional shadows, reflections, rim lights, floor or background. No geometry changes, extra pins, embellishments, parts, perspective changes, crops or contact shadows.
View: FRONT, using guide_front.png. This is a very thin horizontal side elevation centered at y=512, spanning x=66..957 and y=447..576. Keep both large white end housings, the long narrow white central side wall, the thin cyan upper edge, the existing small raised gold parts at x=432..631, and the ONE visible short gold pin silhouette at each far end exactly where the guide places them. The zigzag is hidden by this edge-on camera: do not expose its broad top, rotate it, or add multiple visible pin silhouettes. Keep every existing overlap.
